summary: BOTS end-to-end test: 31/31 backend pytest cases passed (auth, structure, entity CRUD + optimistic concurrency, agent SSOT, relationships/impact, phase advancement gates, assessment unknown-exclusion, publish/snapshots/diff, tenant isolation for viewer/isolated, group oversight dedupe+restricted_count, admin-only export, AI status + suggest). Frontend: login via demo button + Sign-in works for owner; shell renders header controls (workspace-switcher, scope-selector, state-toggle, version-toggle), full left nav (operating_map, capability_model, value_chain, roadmap, executive, opportunity, agent, assessment, oversight, settings), Operating Map canvas renders 8 nodes; clicking node opens DetailDrawer with 10 tabs; navigating to every view works; Edit button present (Save appears only in edit-mode as expected).

issues: Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle — a11y console warning (screen reader). Wrap title with VisuallyHidden or add DialogTitle.

action_items: (Optional, a11y) Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) inside shadcn DialogContent used by DetailDrawer to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~590 lines — within acceptable range but approaching the split threshold; consider breaking entity CRUD, assessment, publish, oversight into separate routers.
login_attempts uses ip:email key but lockout timer resets on every failed attempt (locked_until is set each time) — effectively adds 15 min on every failure. Minor policy consideration.

advance-phase increments version in a $set that also writes data.phase; no conflict since body.version was already validated, but a decision entity is written before the parent update — if the update fails, orphan decision remains. Consider transactional wrapper.
accessible_org_ids / org_role query memberships multiple times per request (N+1 for workspace-admin lookups). Caching per-request would help for list endpoints.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is permitted by FastAPI but violates browser spec — browsers will ignore credentials. Fine for API-only usage with Bearer header; flag for production hardening.
test_credentials: from env: ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD / DEMO_USERS_PASSWORD (values never stored in the repo)
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_opportunity_regression under o-northwind via editor; also added TEST_regression snapshot via publish. Benign demo data under o-northwind, no production impact.

Run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. AI test may skip on 502 if LLM transient. Frontend: use demo-<email> button then click [data-testid=login-submit] (demo button only fills form).
